worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.summary: Hurl a heavy boulder at a direction point or a chosen target: a struck target loses Speed, and on landing the ground under its feet rises into a ring of stone pillars with a walkable gap that seals its movement. A boulder that truly lands on replaceable ground cages that spot too. Only a grounded target can be caged. The siege style cages wider and longer for two Speed stages; the smash style hits harder for one.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.description.0: A living hit takes %1$s non-contact damage with a %2$s block boulder radius; you may aim a direction, a point or an entity, and no enemy is required at commit.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.description.1: You can hurl up to %1$s blocks with a %2$s blocks per tick throw speed.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.description.2: A grounded target gets stone pillars %4$s blocks tall around its feet, with a base radius of %2$s blocks and an exit at least %3$s blocks wide; the actual body leaves extra clearance where needed. Its Speed drops by %1$s stage. The ring lasts %5$s before the original blocks return, but the Speed drop does not end with it. The exit lets the caged target walk out. An airborne target cannot be caged and is not slowed; when the ground is protected or pillars cannot be placed, only rubble scatters but the Speed drop still applies.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.trap.on: Siege style: a wider, taller cage, two Speed stages and a longer-lasting ring, but a lighter blow.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.trap.off: Smash style: a heavier boulder, one Speed stage, a narrower and shorter cage.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.growth.0: From level %1$s the boulder rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.growth.1: From level %1$s the boulder rises to %2$s and the cage lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.use.0: Single-target Speed drop against a charger or a runner
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.use.1: Pin a target in place with a ring of pillars
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.use.2: Skip airborne foes and cage the ones standing still
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.preference.tr: On: a wider, taller ring, two Speed stages and a longer-lived cage, at the cost of a lighter blow. Off: a heavier boulder, one Speed stage and a narrower, shorter cage.
worldcombat.skill.rocktomb.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of hurling. Larger values open with the cage from further out.
On: prefer a target that is moving or fleeing, and rank airborne or already-encased targets last. Off: treat it as an ordinary mid-range attack.
world_combat.move.rocktomb.text.shatter: The target was airborne; the boulder broke
world_combat.move.rocktomb.text.wall: The boulder shattered on the wall
world_combat.move.rocktomb.text.blocked: No pillars could rise; the movement is still slowed
